de: The Instruction of 12 April 1588 was enacted, which is widely regarded as the formal establishment of the Dutch Republic.

de: The Spanish Armada, with 130 ships and 30,000 men, sets sail from Lisbon, Portugal, heading for the English Channel. (It will take until May 30 for all ships to leave port.)

dz: 丰臣藏道士在全国颁布"猎剑法令",解除农民武装,使武士和平民阶级牢牢地分出来,防止农民起义,进一步集中了自己的力量.
de: Toyotomi Hideyoshi issues a nationwide sword hunting ordinance, disarming the peasantry so as to firmly separate the samurai and commoner classes, prevent peasant uprisings, and further centralise his own power.

de: Thomas Cavendish in his ship Desire enters Plymouth and completes the first deliberately planned voyage of circumnavigation.
